title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - GridMeter
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/GridMeter. Metering device that remotely records real electricity consumption. This device allows to control all the information regarding consumption for any time range, automatically and remotely. Subclass of saref:Meter (core SAREF); inherited saref:Meter/saref:Device properties (e.g. hasManufacturer, hasModel) are documented on the core SAREF Meter model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'GridMeter'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasActivityCalendar.description: Relationship. The activity calendar of a meter.

hasClock.description: Relationship. The clock of the meter.

hasFirmware.description: Relationship. The firmware of the meter.

hasNetworkInterface.description: Relationship. The network interface of the meter.

hasProfileGeneric.description: Relationship. The profile generic of a meter.

hasScriptTable.description: Relationship. The script table of a meter.

hasSingleScheduledAction.description: Relationship. The single scheduled action of a meter.

hasPropertyValue.description: Relationship (saref:hasPropertyValue, core SAREF). Links the meter to a saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF class, not modelled in this standard) whose saref:isValueOfProperty must be a MeterProperty instance -- this is how a GridMeter's own property values (e.g. PowerLimit, Manufacturer, ScreenDisplay) are attached to it.
